You might be interested in the following:

  • Will the Matriarchs Save the Crown In Uganda's Tooro Kingdom?

    Since the death of King Oyo Nyimba Kabamba Iguru Rukidi IV of Uganda's western Tooro Kingdom, a lingering controversy has emerged about his successor. The Independent newspaper reports that the divide reflects two competing factions: elders who have moved to install television anchor Prince Edward Rukidi Kijanangoma - setting aside what is reported to be the late king's written will - and the women of the palace.

    Read more »

  • South Africa's Former Deputy President Mlambo-Ngcuka Dies

    Tributes are pouring in after former South African deputy president and UN executive director of UN Women, Phumzile Mlambo-Ngcuka, died.

    Read more »

    • Africa: Statement By The African Women Leaders Network (AWLN) On The Passing Of H.E. Dr. Phumzile Mlambo-Ngcuka
    • Africa: UNAIDS Mourns Dr Phumzile Mlambo-Ngcuka, Former Executive Director of UN Women and Champion of the HIV Response

  • Leaked Sex Tape - Tanzanian Socialite to Remain in Jail

    The popular socialite Amber Rutty was arrested after being filmed having sex with two men. Under Tanzanian laws, which prohibit anal sex, Amber Rutty, real name Rutfiya Abubakari, risks up to 30 years jail term or life imprisonment if found guilty of the crime. 

    Read more »

    • Tanzania: Socialite Amber Rutty, Filmed Having Anal Sex, to Stay Longer in Jail
    • Tanzania: Socialite Amber Rutty Faces Jail Time Over Leaked Anal Sex Tape

  • Millions of Ghanaians Practice Open Defecation, Report Finds

    More than six million Ghanaians practice open defecation despite efforts by the government and its partners to improve sanitation in the country, according to statistics from World Vision.
